exposure: standardized care bundle for surgical procedures (peri-operative antibiotics use, peri-operative glycemic control, preoperative skin preparation, maintaining intra-operative body temperature)
cohort: The study included 6059 surgical procedures performed at a single hospital between 2017 and 2020, divided into pre-bundle (2010 procedures) and post-bundle (4049 procedures) groups.
finding: The incidence rates of SSIs and the standardized infection ratio were significantly lower after the application of a standardized care bundle, with full adherence to all bundle components being key to effectively reducing SSI risk.
